feats.title: Assured Healing
feats.description: When you miss with a divine attack power with the healing keyword, and that power has no effect on a miss, you or one ally within 5 squares of you regains hit points equal to your Charisma.

feats.title: Dazing Rebuke
feats.description: Whenever you hit an undead creature with your turn undead class feature, you can choose to make the target dazed instead of immobilized.

feats.title: Divine Cleansing
feats.description: When you deal damage to at least one undead enemy with your turn undead, each ally in the power's burst can make a saving throw.

feats.title: Extended Healing
feats.description: The burst of your healing word increases by 5.

feats.title: Gambler's Word
feats.description: Once per encounter, when you score a critical hit, you gain an additional use of your healing word power during this encounter.

feats.title: Merciful Power
feats.description: Each target of your healer's mercy can make a saving throw.

feats.title: Merciful Shift
feats.description: Each target of your healer's mercy power can shift 1 square as a free action.

feats.title: Radiant Vessel
feats.description: If you hit an enemy with a cleric attack power that has the radiant keyword, the next time you use healing word before the end of your next turn the target regains 2d6 additional hit points.

feats.title: Swift Turning
feats.description: You can use your turn undead as a minor action instead of a standard action.

feats.title: Undead Ward
feats.description: Your turn undead class feature gains the zone keyword. Whenever you use this power, the burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. Any undead creature that enters or starts its turn within the zone takes 1d6 + Wisdom radiant damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

feats.title: Warding Shield
feats.requirements: 11th level, proficiency with light or heavy shields
feats.description: When you are using a shield, allies adjacent to you gain a +2 shield bonus to Reflex.
